notes:
Account background: Orbitum builds a product analytics assistant embedded in their web app (in-app chat + contextual doc search). Mid-market, strong growth (trial-to-paid focus). Team: Head of Product (Elena Morris), Platform Eng (Victor Raza), Infosec reviewer (J. Alvarez).

Recent activity (shorthand):
- 2026-02-04: Intro call (Ava). Quick demo of Hosted API, initial interest in Hosted -> Dedicated path.
- 2026-02-18: Hosted POC kickoff. Configured model variants + streaming. Fireflies ff-20260218-8792.
- 2026-02-26: POC run: 72h traffic replay from production (subset). Results uploaded (/drive/poc/results/orbitum-poc-2026-02-26.csv).
- 2026-03-02: Security questionnaire submitted, SOC2 + data residency flagged.
- 2026-03-08: Follow-up demo for product team (showed caching, prefix reuse).
- 2026-03-10: Sizing call (Ava + Marcus + Victor + Elena). Agreed to draft dedicated sizing and pricing options. Gmail thread gt-20260219-hr9m3b.

POC findings (hosted trial -> observed metrics):
- Workload mix: 65% chat, 25% doc-search (embeddings + rerank), 10% background summarization jobs.
- Average tokens per chat request: prompt 85 tokens, response 140 tokens (avg round-trip ~225 tokens).
- Embeddings: mean corpus vectorization 1.8k tokens / request (batching applied).
- Measured 95th p95 latency (hosted trial, warm cache): chat gen = 220ms per token, end-to-end median = 420ms. Rerank latency ~180ms per call.
- Observed peak QPS during replay: 58 QPS (chat-heavy window). Sustained QPS outside peak: 12–18 QPS.
- Concurrency observed (simulated): 110 concurrent open sessions at peak window; average concurrent active model calls ~= 42.
- Token mix (by token count): 72% generation tokens, 28% embedding/other.

Redwood sizing & forecast (recommended for Dedicated evaluation):
- Target SLA: p95 latency < 600ms end-to-end for chat interactive flows, support 99.9% uptime for reserved pool.
- Peak provisioning scenario (target): support 80 QPS aggregate to allow headroom for growth/bursty events.
- Concurrency target: sustain 200 concurrent sessions (approx 120 active model contexts) to cover 2x current peak.
- Token throughput estimate: using observed token mix and avg tokens per request, estimated sustained token generation = ~1.1M tokens/min at 80 QPS (225 tokens/request * 80 qps * 60s).
- Embedding throughput: plan for batch workers to handle 10k vectors/hr initially; dedicated batch nodes recommended separate from low-latency pool.
- Suggested Dedicated profile: 2 reserved inference nodes (primary pool) sized for low-latency interactive traffic + 1 burst node for batch embeddings. Typical config tested in POC: 2x inference nodes with autoscale burst to 3 nodes during peak windows.
- Fallback policy: route <10% of requests to hosted lower-cost model variant under overload (agreed conceptually).

Pricing / procurement notes:
- Orbitum wants a predictable committed monthly price for Dedicated with burst credits. Finance asked for a 12-month and 24-month breakdown.
- Sensitive to per-token delta vs Hosted; need unit economics comparison for ~6 months of runway.

Security / deployment constraints:
- Must run control plane in Redwood-hosted region but inference in VPC (customer-managed peering). Infosec insists on KMS integration and audit logging retention 12 months.
- Data residency: customer data must remain in NA region.

Quotes / paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "We need repeatable latency and predictable cost — can't have nightly spikes blow up our bill." — Elena (Head of Product)
- "If we can get a deterministic slot-based price we can sign a 12mo commit." — Victor (Platform Eng)

Open items / blockers to close before procurement:
- Final dedicated sizing worksheet (Marcus) with cost per node and burst pricing (deliverable 2026-03-17).
- Infosec sign-off on VPC peering and KMS integration (owner: J. Alvarez).
- Finance to review ARR band (Orbitum expects to land in $100k–$180k ARR/year if committed).

Suggested next steps (short bullets):
- Deliver dedicated sizing + two pricing scenarios (12mo commit, 24mo commit).
- Run a short 48h dedicated pilot (canary nodes) to validate p95 latencies under live traffic replay.
- Submit bespoke security addendum for KMS and audit log retention.
- Schedule final exec review wk of 2026-03-24.
